author: Sonja Sahebzad

training.data: Existing official local training pool only; no new external data

microbatch_rule: Fastest observed pilot that fits the 8 GiB GPU; small pilots measure feasibility, not a precise speed guarantee
candidate_definition: One common prefill; sorted top256 eligible token IDs with logit descending/token ID ascending ties; width64 is its prefix; each union includes same R20, never supplied options
shared_scoring: Score largest free union and separate options once; rank each independent free set by whole-word score descending then lexical word
timing_sample: First20 cases per source in unchanged development CSV,60 total; independent width calls, warm model, same sample every checkpoint
selection: All18 seed/stage/width artifacts required; select group mean top3, mean top1, mean timing; representative nearest group mean top3, then mean top1, then declared seed order
primary: Development-selected representative versus prior operational local256 on fresh final900; paired top3 source-stratified line bootstrap10000, seed20261490; exact two-sided McNemar
promotion: Positive95% paired bootstrap lower bound AND exact paired p<0.05; otherwise retain prior operational model
secondary: Evaluate other two fixed seeds at same selected stage/width on final; mean outcomes per line with conditional descriptive interval, not an ensemble or future-seed uncertainty
implementation_note: Evaluator implementation and neutral equivalence checks must be hashed before development scoring; hypotheses/data/selection fixed here before official training
limitations: Synthetic four-choice results are not quiz accuracy
Repeated use of development600 can overfit; final900 remains reserved until selection
